title: Plugging Jev into a time series foundation model (designed for forecasting)
author: network-kai
selftext:
I know a bunch of you use Jev already. I saw some posts connecting it to an LLM. Is anyone using it with a time series foundation model? TSFMs are small models that predict outcomes based on sequences of events. The SOTA models are open-source as well (made by Google, IBM, Mistral) so they're free to use.

You can use them to forecast events quickly, and then use Jev (or another decision model) to execute trades fast. Thing is both TSFMs and decision models are so lightweight that they're easy as hell to set up.

This goes into details on how to do it. You can install TSFMs on your own computer (as the SOTA models are like 209M params so they're tiny). But you can also grab inference from other places as well on the cheap

This discusses how to use them together, and posts some results as well: [https://x.com/cascade\_sn91/status/2117296098666787065](https://x.com/cascade_sn91/status/2117296098666787065)
